difficulty: Specialty · Hands-on experience in the relevant domain recommended
prerequisites: None (recommended: 5 years of IT security experience and 2 years of securing AWS workloads)

faq.q: How many questions are on the SCS-C03 exam, and how long is it?
faq.a: SCS-C03 has 65 questions and a time limit of 170 minutes. Questions are multiple-choice, multiple-response, ordering, and matching.
A score of 750 or higher out of 1000 is required to pass. Scores are scaled to account for question difficulty, so they are not the same as a simple percentage of correct answers.

faq.q: How much does the exam cost, and how do I register?
faq.a: The exam fee is US $300. You can take it through Pearson VUE at a test center or as an online proctored exam. There is no free retake, so you pay the full fee each time you sit the exam.

faq.q: How long is the certification valid, and how do I recertify?
faq.a: The certification is valid for 3 years after you pass, and you must recertify before it expires. Passing the exam earns you a 50% discount voucher for your next exam, which you can use to recertify or to take another AWS certification.

faq.q: Can I take the exam in Korean?
faq.a: Yes. The exam is offered in 6 languages, including Korean. You can choose your language when you register for the exam.
